name: SikaRoof VersiDrain 8 Geotextile
paste:
SIKAROOF® VERSIDRAIN® 8 GEOTEXTILE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile, August 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikaroof-versidrain8geotextile.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile is a drainage and protection sheet produced from high density polyethylene (HDPE) with dimples 8 mm deep and a filtration layer of geotextile (PP) bonded on the top.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. As a drainage and protection sheet for preformed sheet membrane waterproofing systems, waterproofing mortars and coatings, and Sika® White Box concept for waterproofing basements.
    - Planter Boxes
    - Retaining Walls
    - Basement walls
    - Roof Tops with decorative gravel
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Dimpled Drainage Sheet and Waterproof protection layer
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Geotextiles and geotextile-related products - Characteristics required for use in drainage systems' according to EN 13252, Declaration of Performance Nr.78023926 certified by notified factory production control certification body 1213 and provided with the CE marking.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 13252: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - EN ISO 9863-1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Thickness (p.2).
    - EN 10319: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Elongation (p.2); Product Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - High drainage capacity
    - Integrated filtration layer
    - Can be installed on damp and even wet substrates
    - Resistant to all natural aggressive mediums in ground water and soil
    - Suitable for contact with soft water (aggressive to concrete)
    - SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile forms a drainage channel in the space between the structural elements and the back filling/soil/substrate to allow water to be drained away.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Brown or black HDPE sheet with 8 mm deep dimples and a white geotextile filtration layer bonded on top.
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile strength: Tensile strength 10 (-2) kN/m (machine and cross direction) (EN 10319)
    - Elongation: Elongation 50 (±12.5) % (machine and cross direction) (EN 10319)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Roll size 2.00 × 20.00 m ( 40m² total )
    - Shelf life: Shelf life 5 years from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging
    - Storage conditions: Rolls must be stored in their original packaging and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality. Clean, sound and dry, homogeneous, free from oils and grease, dust and loose or friable particles.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: Thickness 8.0 (±0.8) mm (EN ISO 9863-1)
4.3 Drain flow capacity.
    | Horizontal application at 20 kPa | 0.30 l/(m·s) ± 20 % |
    | (S/R, i= 0.04) |
    | Vertical application at 20 kPa | 1.9 l/(m·s) ± 20 % |
    | (S/R, i= 1) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Application method / tools - Installation method. Loose laid and mechanically fastened in accordance with the relevant Sika® application manual and installation instructions.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Maximum installation depth: 5 m.
    - SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile is not resistant against exposure to permanent weathering and sunlight.
    - When used in combination with PVC membranes, a separation layer (geotextile) must be used between the materials.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient maximum temperature of liquids. +30 °C (water)
5.3 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +45 °C max.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile, August 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikaroof-versidrain8geotextile.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
